Elena —

Got it, thanks for sending the redlines. We can meet both asks; outline below and we can lock details after Marissa confirms DocuSign setup.

Planned DocuSign configuration (initial plan):
- ID verification: Email OTP + DocuSign ID Check (government ID scan) for primary signer.
- Signing order: Sequential — Redwood signs last to ensure countersignature order.
- Delegation/fallback: Primary: CFO (Victor Hsu). Fallback: COO (Alicia Kramer) with witness attestation step (witness signs after delegation triggered). We will capture delegation acceptance as an inline acknowledgement in the envelope.
- Deliverables: Fully executed PDFs for both MSA and Order Form, plus the DocuSign Certificate of Completion (audit trail PDF). Final clean copies will be uploaded to the HubSpot deal and delivered to your counsel.

Action for legal ops: Marissa/Ben, can you prepare a routing matrix with roles, phone verification, and a fallback step that triggers witness signing? Please also confirm whether we need phone-based verification in addition to OTP to satisfy your compliance team.

I will hold off on sending the envelope until we have the final routing matrix and your confirmation on phone verification.

Thanks —
Karthik
Head of Sales Operations

Karthik / Ben —

Draft routing matrix attached. Key points:
- Envelope will be split into two sequential recipients: BrightCare signers -> Redwood countersigners.
- Recipient 1: Victor Hsu (CFO) — DocuSign ID Check + Email OTP. If recipient 1 declines or does not complete within 48 hours, envelope automatically reassigns to Alicia Kramer (COO) as fallback.
- Witness: We will add an additional signer role (Witness) that is conditional — it is inserted only if fallback is used. Witness will be required to provide name and email; no special ID verification.
- Phone verification: DocuSign SMS OTP can be enabled for both primary and fallback signers. BrightCare has to confirm the phone numbers.
- Audit trail and clean copy: We will enable the Certificate of Completion and export a flattened PDF for both MSA and Order Form; the clean copy will have signature blocks removed and will be stored in RDW S3 with a checksum.

Attachments: routing_matrix_docusign.xlsx (xlsx)
